cases.translation: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: я был в точности научен ___ наших отцов.
cases.translation: I was strictly taught according to the law of our fathers.
cases.explain: The verb 'научен' (taught) takes the dative case for what someone is taught.

cases.sentence: Я преследовал и мучил до смерти последователей пути Иисуса, арестовывал ___ и женщин.
cases.translation: I persecuted to the death the followers of the Way, arresting men and women.
cases.explain: After the coordinated accusative of 'женщин', the genitive plural is used in parallel construction.

cases.sentence: По пути, когда я уже подходил к Дамаску, около полудня меня вдруг озарил ослепительный свет с ___.
cases.translation: As I was approaching Damascus, about noon, a bright light from heaven suddenly shone around me.
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я упал на землю и услышал голос, который говорил мне, «Савл, зачем ты преследуешь ___?»
cases.translation: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, 'Saul, why are you persecuting me?'
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'преследуешь' (persecuting) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он ответил, «Я Иисус из ___,которого ты преследуешь».
cases.translation: He said, 'I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting.'
cases.explain: The genitive case is used to express the origin or source (Иисус из Назарета — Jesus of Nazareth).

cases.sentence: Мои спутники за руку привели меня в ___.
cases.translation: Those with me led me by the hand to Damascus.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) with motion requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я стоял там и одобрял это, я сторожил ___ его убийц.
cases.translation: I stood there approving and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'сторожил' (guarded) requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Я Иудей, уроженец Тарса в Киликии, но воспитывался я в этом городе у Гамалеила и был в точности научен закону наших отцов.
reading.question: Where was Paul born and where was he brought up?
options: He was born in Tarsus of Cilicia but brought up in Jerusalem at the feet of Gamaliel
He was born in Jerusalem and stayed there his whole life
He was born in Damascus and grew up in Antioch
He was born in Rome and educated in Athens
reading.correct: He was born in Tarsus of Cilicia but brought up in Jerusalem at the feet of Gamaliel
reading.explain: Paul said 'Я Иудей, уроженец Тарса в Киликии, но воспитывался я в этом городе у Гамалеила' — born in Tarsus but brought up in Jerusalem.

reading.ru: Я преследовал и мучил до смерти последователей пути Иисуса, арестовывал мужчин и женщин и отправлял их в темницы.
reading.question: What did Paul do before his conversion?
options: He persecuted to death the followers of the Way, arresting men and women and putting them in prison
He preached the gospel to Jews and Gentiles
He was a Roman official and judge
He was a merchant and traveled throughout the Mediterranean
reading.correct: He persecuted to death the followers of the Way, arresting men and women and putting them in prison
reading.explain: Paul confessed 'я преследовал и мучил до смерти последователей пути' — I persecuted to death the followers of the Way.

reading.ru: По пути, когда я уже подходил к Дамаску, около полудня меня вдруг озарил ослепительный свет с неба.
reading.question: What happened to Paul on the road to Damascus?
options: A bright light from heaven suddenly shone around him about noon
He met an angel in a dream
reading.correct: A bright light from heaven suddenly shone around him about noon
reading.explain: Paul described 'около полудня меня вдруг озарил ослепительный свет с неба' — about noon a bright light from heaven shone around me.

reading.ru: Я упал на землю и услышал голос, который говорил мне, «Савл, Савл, зачем ты преследуешь меня?»
reading.question: What did the voice say to Paul on the Damascus road?
options: 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'
'Turn back from this path you are taking'
'Go to Rome and preach the gospel'
reading.correct: 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?'
reading.explain: Paul heard a voice saying 'Савл, Савл, зачем ты преследуешь меня?' — Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?

reading.ru: Он ответил, «Я Иисус из Назарета, которого ты преследуешь».
reading.question: Who identified himself to Paul on the road to Damascus?
reading.explain: The voice said 'Я Иисус из Назарета' — I am Jesus of Nazareth.

reading.ru: Там ко мне пришел человек по имени Анания, тщательно соблюдающий закон и уважаемый всеми местными иудеями.
reading.question: Who came to Paul in Damascus after his vision on the road?
options: A man named Ananias, devout according to the law and respected by all the local Jews
The high priest of the temple
reading.correct: A man named Ananias, devout according to the law and respected by all the local Jews
reading.explain: Paul recalled 'человек по имени Анания, тщательно соблюдающий закон и уважаемый всеми местными иудеями' — a man named Ananias, devout according to the law.
